key:<Space>gp.note: opens the Policy section of the manager view for the project (GetHarnessManager + GetHarnessManagerPolicy)

key:<Space>gb.note: opens the manager Board: the Overview, Decisions, Requests and Health first pages (GetHarnessManagerState)

key:<Space>gd.note: opens the Decisions section (GetHarnessManagerState section decisions)

cmd:manager.note: opens the manager view on the Board

cmd:manager-scope.note: opens the scope picker (ListHarnessManagerScope pages, ConfigureHarnessManager save)

cmd:manager-appoint.note: opens the scope picker with the selected session as the seat; Enter saves the appointment (ConfigureHarnessManager)

cmd:manager-clear.note: asks, then revokes supervision with the explicit empty selection (ConfigureHarnessManager)

cmd:global-manager.note: opens the global manager workspace; :gm and :manager workspace are its aliases

cmd:manager-global.note: bare :manager global opens the workspace with the grant in its header; show prints the grant line; set <active|sessions|containers|spend|groups> <value> [confirm], add-project <names>, configure <JSON> and prefill [projects] send ConfigureGlobalManager built by the TUI's rules (manager_ops.rs over rsi_common::global_manager); a cap-reduction refusal opens a review and y resends with confirm_cap_reductions

cmd:manager-global-revoke.note: asks, then RevokeGlobalManager with the grant version read just before

cmd:manager-portfolio.note: list (active nodes), show <node>, appoint <label> [--adopt <nodes>] [projects] (prefilled from the last revoked root, or a covering grant above adopted nodes), launch add|remove <node> <Provider/model[/effort]>... (ConfigurePortfolioNodeLaunches), configure <JSON> and revoke <node> (asks first; RevokePortfolioNode at its current versions); nodes resolve by id, 4+ character prefix or unique label

cmd:manager-escalations.note: list / all open the queue (escalations, top-of-chain reports, undelivered tier mail with its next-page cursor); rule <hop> <text> (RuleOperatorEscalation), ack <notice> (AcknowledgeOperatorNotice) and undelivered [<cursor>] (ListOperatorEscalations undelivered_after); hop and notice ids resolve by a unique 4+ character prefix

cmd:manager-friction.note: the friction rollup (ListFrictionRollup); :manager friction <hours> widens the window (1..720)

overlay:harness-manager-scope-manager-ap.note: j/k g/G, Space toggles with the TUI Group/Epic rules and 32 limits, a whole project, / filter (a modal field), Enter saves (an empty explicit selection asks, then revokes), Esc/q; [x] explicit, [+] inherited; unavailable selections stay listed for removal

overlay-ref:manager-scope.note: every key of the Manager Scope table

overlay:harness-manager-policy-manager-p.note: rows: Preset (Observe / Execute / Full project control through rsi_common's apply_manager_policy_preset; the row shows the preset the draft matches, Custom otherwise), Use suggested allowances (apply_suggested_manager_allowances), mode, operator pause, capabilities, Group creation, quotas, retry count and delay, request timeout, spend cap, reviewer tier, Paused Epics / Group grants / Provider ceilings / Daemon setting bounds as JSON lists, Allowed launches in a picker (catalog checks plus typed Provider/model[/effort]), and Advanced (every field as JSON); list and Advanced edits pass ManagerPolicyV2::validate before reaching the draft; s saves the whole policy fenced on scope and policy versions (an unchanged retry keeps its key), r reloads; a revoked grant is labelled and s regrants the draft

overlay-ref:manager-policy.note: 1-5, Tab / Shift-Tab, [ ], j/k, g/G, Enter/Space, s, r, Esc/q
